datasetName: Metropolitan Transport Corporation (MTC) Chennai Bus Foundation
operator: Metropolitan Transport Corporation (Chennai) Ltd. — Government of Tamil Nadu Undertaking

coverage.operatingJurisdiction: Greater Chennai Metropolitan Area, Tambaram Corporation, and designated regional permit corridors into Chengalpattu, Kanchipuram, and Tiruvallur

licenseAndAttribution: Public transit timetable data compiled from MTC mobile application API. Curated GTFS compilation licensed under ODbL / PDDL by UngalSoththu. Underlying MTC timetable redistribution rights unconfirmed.
limitationsAndCaveats: Raw GTFS snapshot (7 files: agency, calendar, feed_info, routes, stops, stop_times, trips) imported into data/mtc_bus/imported/ with byte-for-byte SHA-256 verification and strictly isolated from production journey routing (readyForJourneyRouting: false).

Accessibility Reality: MTC buses are almost exclusively high-floor chassis (850-900mm entrance) without mechanical wheelchair lifts; bus terminus boarding curbs are not uniformly step-free. Blanket step-free access is NOT supported by physical evidence.

Regional Coverage Reality: Bus stands in Chengalpattu (CGLB) and Sriperumbudur (SPBD) are primarily TNSTC/municipal bus terminals with designated MTC bays for long-distance city services, not standalone MTC facilities.
CUMTA's official static GTFS feed stamped 4,721 trips with dummy 00:00:15 timestamps. UngalSoththu feed resolves this by scraping real scheduled departures from the official MTC app.
Real-time vehicle locations (GPS feeds / Chalo MTC Live) are restricted behind commercial API gateways and are not publicly available as open GTFS-RT.
Free bus travel (Vidiyal Payanam) is valid only on Ordinary / White Board services, not on Deluxe, Express, or AC services.
